question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He gave the horse enough room to ______ away from the wagon.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Walk**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, the context indicates that the horse needs space to move away from the wagon.
 
• The sentence requires a verb that describes the horse moving away from the wagon, and "walk" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The word "**walk**" is suitable in this context because it implies that the horse is moving on its own feet at a leisurely pace, which is consistent with the idea of providing enough room for it to move.
 
• So, the sentence would read: "*He gave the horse enough room to walk __away from the wagon,*" suggesting that the horse has space to move away from the wagon at a comfortable pace.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Woke **means to become alert or conscious. (सचेत या जागरूक होना)
 
• **Stalk **means to pursue or track something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति का पीछा करना या उसका पता लगाना)
 
• **Watch **means to observe or monitor. (निरीक्षण करना)
